description.narrative: EUR 20m equity investment (2024) in R-GOL, the largest specialty provider of football goods in Poland, to finance the acquisition of a 100% stake in a Western Europe-based peer (the "EU Target"), the leading football goods specialist e-commerce retailer in its home region. This acquisition was motivated by a strong strategic fit, complementary geographical presence, compatible distribution channels, and high potential for synergies, with the combined entity set to become the #2 player in Europe. Capitilizing on this first successful transaction, a EUR 5m follow-on equity investment in May 2025 will allow the acquisition of a USA-based peer (the "US Target"), strengthening the international position of the group, tapping into the strcuturally dynamic US market, and preparing for the 2026 world cup in North America.
